prompt:
Subject:
A blooming white alley

Main Subject:
A full-body vertical photo of a single woman standing and smiling in a seaside alley with white walls and blue doors. The main elements are a pale yellow swimsuit and wrap, vibrant pink flowers overhead, and the blue sea in the far right.

Person/Expression:
Body and face almost front-facing, brown eyes directed at the camera, a bright smile showing teeth. Small oval face with a round chin, rounded almond-shaped eyes, thin parallel eyebrows, slender nose bridge, natural pink lips. Fair skin with pale blush and subtle eye makeup. Light brown long hair with thin bangs and large loose waves flowing down to the chest.

Clothing/Pose:
A pale yellow bandeau bikini swimsuit with thin shoulder straps and a three-dimensional floral ornament in the center. A short wrap skirt of the same color in a lace style tied in a large ribbon at the right hip, with matching bottoms visible underneath. Yellow thin-strap heel sandals. Right hand placed near the hair by the right ear, left arm hanging naturally, standing with legs crossed.

Background/Light:
On the left is a blue wooden door, white plaster wall, wooden chair, and table with white cloth. White cobblestones, buildings with blue windows, and outdoor seating continue toward the center background, with the sea and a small boat in the far right background. Branches densely covered in pink flowers are above. Hard direct sunlight from the sun above casts leaf shadows on the walls and alley.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical, full-body portrait from head to shoes at eye level. The person occupies the center-left largely, leaving the alley on the right as depth leading to the sea. Focus on the person, with a medium depth of field keeping the cityscape clear.

Texture/Style:
A high-key photorealistic live-action photo. Brightly and finely depicts white plaster, cobblestones, flowers, lace fabric, and skin, with fresh blue, white, pale yellow, and pink colors.

Negative:
Do not omit the floral ornament in the center of the swimsuit; do not remove the right-hip ribbon on the wrap skirt.
